## Batch 47 authored

The A/B pages are frontmatter-only: [fd-pbl01](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/fluid-dynamics/fd-pbl01.md:2) and [fd-pbl01-examples](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/fluid-dynamics/fd-pbl01-examples.md:2). The [postulate](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/post-fd-capillary-linear-free-surface.md:44), [dispersion theorem](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/pthm-fd-capillary-wave-model-prediction.md:41), and [example](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/items/ex-fd-capillary-restoring-sign.md:38) are complete and remain draft. The theorem proves the finite-depth relation \(\omega^2=(gk+(\gamma/\rho)k^3)\tanh(kh)\) for the stated periodic modes; its source treatments include [MIT lecture notes](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-354j-nonlinear-dynamics-ii-continuum-systems-spring-2015/6163837c5efa5d6ed969e535ec8f890c_MIT18_354JS15_lectureNotes.pdf), [Georgi’s textbook](https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/8-03sc-physics-iii-vibrations-and-waves-fall-2016/ef731c1b91d77a6db003f6c27e300d25_MIT8_03SCF16_Textbook.pdf), and [Fitzpatrick’s fluid mechanics notes](https://farside.ph.utexas.edu/teaching/336L/Fluidhtml/node156.html).

The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/fluid-dynamics-all-47-2026-10-23-batch-47.notes.md:1), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/fluid-dynamics-all-47-2026-10-23-batch-47.proof-contracts.json), source coverage, manifest, and [cross-batch dependency rows](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/fluid-dynamics-all-47-2026-10-23-batch-47.cross-batch-dependencies.json) are recorded. Source fetch passed 7/7; content policy, focused depcheck, rendercheck, precheck, and proof-layout passed. The assigned item levels recompute to 3/4/5; batch 47 remains level 4 with requirements from batches 9 and 46.
